briefing.text: Demand for the next 12 months is forecast at 1,808,156 units (+6.1% vs the last 12 months) and $1.61 B revenue at the announced 2027 list prices; the 19-month total is 2.82 M units (P10 2.66 M - P90 3.15 M).
The market is in an upturn: orders over the last 3 months are +13.6% year on year against -0.6% over 12 months; peak months are Oct, Sep.
Relative to the market, Electrical Assemblies is outpacing and Chassis & Structural, Powertrain Components are lagging.
The EV shift continues: EV SKUs +27.1% next 12 months (share 9.8% -> 11.8%), ICE SKUs -4.4%.
8 family-region(s) are forecast above their highest 3-month volume shipped in the last 3 years; the largest gap is Chassis & Structural in Middle East & Africa at 106% from the window ending 2027-01.
Next procurement cycle (deliveries in the next 3 months): $561 M of supply at each segment's service level, of which $166 M is safety buffer above the median forecast.
1,735 A-class series carry 80% of next-year revenue; 352 series are hard to forecast (Z) and are planner-owned.
Macro risk: a combined downside (PMI -3, auto production -2 pp, orders -5%, raw materials +10%) cuts the 19-month forecast by 6.9%; the upside adds 4.9%.
62 critical actions this cycle; the top one: Demand shifting from ICE to EV - EV vs ICE (owner: S&OP / Product management).

top_recommendations.title: Demand shifting from ICE to EV
top_recommendations.finding: EV SKUs grow 27.1% next 12 months (share 9.8% -> 11.8%) while ICE SKUs change -4.4% (share 13.1% -> 11.8%).
top_recommendations.action: Shift capacity and procurement toward EV SKUs; set last-time-buy and run-down rules for declining ICE SKUs.
top_recommendations.trade_off: EV ramp risk vs ICE stranded inventory; revenue next 12 m: EV $249,182,269, ICE $208,372,788.

top_recommendations.title: Growing demand on a fragile supply base
top_recommendations.finding: Thermal Management in North America grows 5.7% next 12 months, but had 17 shortage months in 36 months (mostly Tooling breakdown), 577 lost units and a 39.3% average fill rate in those months.
top_recommendations.action: Raise safety stock to the segment's service level, qualify a second source or expedite option for the dominant cause, and review supplier performance before the next order release.
top_recommendations.trade_off: Higher buffer and dual sourcing add cost; $11,819,808 of revenue is due in the next 3 months.

top_recommendations.title: Forecast load above demonstrated throughput
top_recommendations.finding: Brake & Safety Systems in North America: the 3-month forecast load peaks at 18,073 units (window ending 2027-05), 105.3% of the highest 3-month volume shipped in the last 3 years (17,163); P90 load 20,959 units (122.1%). First window above it ends 2027-01; 10 capacity/tooling shortages in 36 months.
top_recommendations.action: Confirm line capacity for about 910 extra units per 3 months before 2027-01: plan extra shifts or pre-build in the preceding low-load months, and lock supplier commitments for the peak window.
top_recommendations.trade_off: Pre-building ties up working capital; not acting risks repeating past capacity shortages.
